newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway expands 12-month T-bill by 4.0 bln crowns.
newsitem.headline: Norway expands 12-month T-bill by 4.0 bln crowns.

text.p: Norway's central bank said on Thursday the Finance Ministry was expanding the SS44 treasury bill by four billion crowns.
The amount will be issued at an ordinary auction with final date for tenders at 0800 GMT on Monday. Settlement is two days later.
The 12-month bill was issued on September 12 with a nominal interest of 5.20 percent per annum. The initial issue was for 4.5 billion crowns, of which 500 million were reserved for the bank.
